claims.sentence: As one of our three sustainability step-change initiatives, our circularity agenda plays a key role in our approach to sustainable innovation.
Sustainable Design Guide: operationalizes the Danfoss Circularity Framework, providing guidelines and practical examples for implementation.
Our overarching Sustainable Design Guide methodology identifies 10 sustainability strategies for new product development and 30 guidelines providing practical advice and tips for implementation.
This Guide forms the basis for our work with sustainable product design as well as our qualitative RE:CIRC tool.
Our internal sustainable design assessment tool is based on our Sustainable Design Guide.
Green Materials Guide: provides practical guidance circularity and carbon data on materials and applications to inform our materials choices.
Practical guidance on carbon footprint and circularity potential of materials, informing our choice of materials in the new product development, and underpinning our Sustainable Design Guide.
Sustainable Packaging tool: assesses the sustainability of packaging options.
By 2030, we aim to have 80% of newly developed products launched covered by Danfoss’ circularity approach.
By 2030, we aim to achieve a 25% increase of circular business revenues compared to our 2023 base year, equal to EUR 287m.
With dedicated teams and established refurbishment lines, we are scaling up our circular service offerings to support more sustainable operations across industries while driving competitiveness.
Stay up to date with recent information from Danfoss, get inspiring content on our sustainable solutions and climate action.
Read successful case stories from our customers and explore how we help lead the sustainable transformation to limit climate change.
